599:t_015:19.en:
$$リディ$$
「But $c was different... I'm sure that here, even I... can believe in the future again...」

599:t_015:20.en:
$$リディ$$
「Even if what awaits us is a mighty power beyond human understanding...」

599:t_016:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...A promise that $$ニュータイプ$$s would participate in the $$連邦政府$$... That's the true nature of $$ラプラスの箱$$...」

599:t_016:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「So it is just as $$フロンタル$$ suspected.」

599:t_016:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$サイアム・ビスト$$ was a clever man. He threatened the government with the monument's existence, but never made unreasonable demands.」

599:t_016:4.en:
$$リディ$$
「He helped the then-emerging $$アナハイム・エレクトロニクス$$ grow, and built the $$ビスト財団$$...」

599:t_016:5.en:
$$オットー$$
「And a symbiotic relationship with the Federation began...」

599:t_016:6.en:
$$オットー$$
「A system maintained by keeping the original monument... $$ラプラスの箱$$... hidden and revered...」

599:t_016:7.en:
$$オットー$$
「Its contents no longer matter. So the Box symbolizes the world's order.」

599:t_016:8.en:
$$リディ$$
「At first, it was at most a scandal that threatened the government of the day.」

599:t_016:9.en:
$$リディ$$
「But the rise of the $$ジオン公国$$ changed everything.」

599:t_016:10.en:
$$リディ$$
「Whether $$ニュータイプ$$s really exist doesn't matter. The fact that the Federation buried that article is the greatest weapon for $$ジオン$$'s believers.」

599:t_016:11.en:
$$リディ$$
「That is why the Box's existence had to remain secret, to keep this world from becoming hell.」

599:t_016:12.en:
$$リディ$$
「But hell came anyway: the hell called the $$一年戦争$$.」

599:t_016:13.en:
$$リディ$$
「The enormity of its casualties, and the war's proof that $$ニュータイプ$$s existed, made the Box's curse even heavier.」

599:t_016:14.en:
$$リディ$$
「That's why my father and the others... why $$クロノ$$, which would not tolerate $$スペースノイド$$s, had to keep the secret.」

599:t_016:15.en:
$$リディ$$
「To deny them hope... a future... they chose to maintain a distorted system and tame the people into submission.」

599:t_016:17.en:
$$リディ$$
「But what is this order we protected...?」

599:t_016:18.en:
$$リディ$$
「I heard her... $$マリーダ$$'s voice, without a doubt...!」

599:t_016:20.en:
$$リディ$$
「We can understand each other... That is a possibility people have, too...」

599:t_016:21.en:
$$リディ$$
「I said I would protect people, but I didn't believe in them. I disappointed everyone and lost everything...」

599:t_017:0.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Those purple machines! Are they $$フロンタル$$'s Royal Guard!?」

599:t_017:1.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「The Colonel has given his permission! All units, fire on $$メガラニカ$$!」

599:t_018:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「So you've come out, $$ユニコーン$$!」

599:t_018:1.en:
$$ネオ・ジオン兵$$
「Commander! There's no pilot aboard that $$ガンダム$$!」

599:t_018:2.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Did our last attack knock it out of the dock?」

599:t_018:3.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Perfect! I'll destroy it before that cheeky brat gets aboard!!」

599:t_021:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$ユニコーン$$... You answered my cry.」

599:t_021:2.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You monster! But I have a way to seal you off!」

599:t_022:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What is this!? The $$サイコミュ$$ is being blocked!」

599:t_022:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「The $$サイコ・ジャマー$$! So they finished it!」

599:t_022:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「It's a system that cancels the $$精神感応波|lc$$ controlling the $$サイコミュ$$ by hitting them with stronger waves!」

599:t_022:4.en:
$$クェス$$
「The $$ユニコーン$$ can't use its power like that!」

599:t_022:5.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「$$バナージ・リンクス$$! I've hated you since the first time we met!」

599:t_022:7.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I won't give in to such one-sided malice!」

599:t_022:8.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「What!? His psychic waves are exceeding our projected values!」

599:t_022:11.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「This is... $$バナージ$$'s light!」

599:t_022:12.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$オードリー$$ is waiting for me, so we can open a path to the future together!」

599:t_022:13.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$ガンダム$$! If you're a machine that guides the future, turn my feelings into power!!」

599:t_023:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Did the $$ユニコーン$$'s $$サイコ・フィールド$$ break through the system!?」

599:t_023:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Go, $$リディ$$! Support $$バナージ$$!」

599:t_023:4.en:
$$オットー$$
「Quit your whining! Do you want a kick in the ass!?」

599:t_025:5.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Please go! Don't let $$マリーダ$$'s feelings be in vain!」

599:t_026:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「I'll atone someday...! But right now...!」

599:t_026:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「Let's do this, $$バナージ$$! We aren't the only ones creating this light!」

599:t_026:4.en:
